title: Publish Version 17 to Live

requirements.text: Publish/deploy application Version 17 to the live environment (production) and make it the active version users see.

quotes: could you push version 17 publish it to live?

acceptanceCriteria: Version 17 is deployed to the live environment and is the active version served to users
A live URL (or confirmation of the existing live URL) is provided for verification

constraints: Do not modify application functionality or code as part of this request; deployment only.
nonGoals: Implementing new features or UI changes
Fixing known issues unless required for the deployment to succeed
